tr_h_list: When a valid user submits a POST request to /auth/login, the system shall authenticate the user.
When a user submits a POST request to /auth/login with an invalid username, the system shall return an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response.
When a user submits a POST request to /auth/login without providing a TOTP code, the system shall return an error message.
When a user submits a POST request to /auth/login with an expired refresh token, the system shall return an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response.
When a user submits a POST request to /auth/login with an invalid refresh token, the system shall return an error message.
When a user logs out, the system shall invalidate their session.
When a user exceeds the maximum number of failed login attempts, the system shall lock their account.
When a user's account is locked, the system shall not allow them to log in.
When a user's account is automatically unlocked, the system shall allow them to log in.
When the rate limit for login attempts is exceeded, the system shall return an error message.
When a user logs in, the system shall record an audit log entry.
When an access token is generated, the system shall sign it using RS256 algorithm.
When a user sets a password, the system shall enforce a minimum of 12 characters with mixed case and symbols.
When the client initiates communication, the system shall use TLS 1.2 or higher.
When an access token is used after issuance, the system shall invalidate it within 15 minutes.
When invalid credentials are submitted, the system shall reject the login attempt.
When the 5th consecutive failed login attempt occurs, the system shall lock the account.
When an account is locked, the system shall unlock it within 15 minutes.
When the client exceeds 10 requests per minute, the system shall reject subsequent requests.
When an access token is used after 15 minutes from issuance, the system shall return an error response.
When invalid credentials are submitted, the system shall return an error response.
When the system detects 5 consecutive failed login attempts, it shall lock the account for 15 minutes.
When the account is locked, the system shall unlock it after 15 minutes.
When the system detects more than 10 requests per minute from a client IP address, it shall return an error response.
When Unauthenticated Client attempts to authenticate, the system shall respond with an access token.
When Registered User requests a new access token, the system shall respond with a new access token within 2 seconds.
When Registered User requests to invalidate their session, the system shall invalidate the user session.
When Unauthenticated Client attempts to authenticate with MFA, the system shall respond with an access token.
When API Gateway receives an access token, the system shall validate the access token.
When AuthController processes an authentication request, the system shall record an audit log entry.
When Unauthenticated Client attempts to login with invalid credentials, the system shall respond with an error message.
When SessionManager detects multiple failed login attempts, the system shall lock the user account.
When Unauthenticated Client requests to authenticate, the system shall respond with an access token or error message within 5 seconds.
When Registered User requests to invalidate their session, the system shall invalidate the user session and update the audit log within 2 seconds.
When API Gateway receives an access token, the system shall validate the access token and update the audit log.
When AuthController processes an authentication request, the system shall record an audit log entry and update the user session.
